别人发的普通文本消息（不是图片/卡片/系统消息，也不是链接/URL——点到链接会打开浏览器），点赞类问题用它
长按消息后出现的点赞 "👍" 表情按钮

checks.expect: The liked message shows a like / 👍 reaction under it

preconditions.text: 会话里有别人发的普通文本消息

trigger.text: On the Teamily iOS app, long-pressing a message whose content is only a link (a URL together with its link preview card, and no accompanying user text - a link-only message) produces no response at all: the message action menu never opens. observable.text: Long-pressing a link-only message should open the same message action menu that text messages get - including at minimum Quote/Reply, Forward, Copy (of the link), Add to My Artifacts, Delete and the emoji reaction row. A link message should not be a second-class citizen in the message action menu.
observable.phenomenon: Long-pressing a link-only message produces no response at all - the action menu never opens. No action can therefore be performed on the message, so quoting / replying to a shared link is impossible. The screenshot shows the link-only message and confirms that no menu / action panel is on screen.

substitution.reason: ios 端当前无可用执行端（设备池只有 Android 真机，Web 用 Playwright）。替代为 android-app（同为原生移动端交互：长按/键盘/触控）或 mobile-web（同一 Web 代码的手机视口 + 触屏）；结论不能直接代表 ios 端。
